propositions: Mode inherits from str and Enum, causing functools.total_ordering to fail to override str's lexical comparison methods
Mode.BOOTSTRAP_THROTTLE > Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK incorrectly returns false because __gt__ uses lexical string ordering instead of rank-based ordering
check_phase_gate fails to block higher reconcile modes when the stored gate is reconcile-check due to incorrect comparison semantics
Rich comparison operators (__gt__, __le__, __ge__) must be explicitly implemented to enforce the rank contract reconcile-check < dry-run < bootstrap-strict < bootstrap-throttle < live
Persisted Mode values, equality semantics, MODE_CAPS constant, and from_str conversion must remain unchanged after the fix
